# MetaForge for Claude Code — local

**Generated by `scripts/build_integrations.py` — do not edit by hand.**

The same plugin as `claude-code/`, run as a local process instead of reached over HTTP. No gateway to start, no URL, no token, no network.

## Install

```
pip install metaforge
/plugin marketplace add FidelOdok/MetaForge
/plugin install metaforge-local
```

`pip install` first: the plugin launches `metaforge-mcp` as a subprocess, so it has to be on your PATH.

## Which package

Install **one**. The manifest format has no way to switch a server entry off, so a package that declared both an HTTP and a stdio server would connect to both — every tool twice.

| | `metaforge` | `metaforge-local` |
|---|---|---|
| Reaches | a gateway over HTTP | a process on this machine |
| Needs | a gateway running, and its URL | `pip install metaforge` |
| Suits | a team or hosted gateway | working on your own |

## What runs locally

Everything the gateway package exposes. The server starts with no environment set at all and registers its adapters; anything it cannot reach is named by `/metaforge:doctor` rather than quietly missing from the tool list.

Persistent stores (Neo4j, Postgres) are optional — without them the twin is in-memory and does not survive a restart. That is a real limit, not a degraded mode to discover later: `health/check` says what is reachable.

## Skills

32 engineering skills are bundled.

## Writes wait for a human

A local stdio session is treated as the engineer at the machine, so writes run without being held — unless your client supports MCP elicitation, in which case it asks you inline. Either way the rule is enforced server-side, not by the client.
